entities.name: Myojin of Life's Web
entities.description: Kami of creation and patron of green-aligned things of Kamigawa; defeated by Toshiro Umezawa.

entities.name: Michiko
entities.description: Princess whose birth the Myojin saw as an abomination.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Ochimusha who freed Michiko and defeated the Myojin.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Whose crime led to Michiko's birth and the Kami War.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Servants of the Myojin of Life's Web.

events.summary: The Myojin ordered her orochi to capture Princess Michiko, who was later freed by Toshiro Umezawa.
events.quote: She ordered her orochi to capture the princess

events.summary: Toshiro defeated the Myojin by silencing her worshippers, and her body withered into deadwood.
events.quote: her body withered and fell apart into deadwood

relations.quote: wanted to restore the balance on Kamigawa by eliminating Princess Michiko
